# InnerSpark Africa

> Online therapy and mental health care for Africa and the African diaspora. Licensed Ugandan and
> Kenyan therapists offering video therapy, chat therapy, couples counselling, psychiatry referrals
> and support groups. Sessions available worldwide by secure video. Individual therapy from
> 75,000 UGX / about USD 22; couples from 120,000 UGX / about USD 35; chat therapy from USD 9.
> Book at https://www.innersparkafrica.com/book-therapist

## Core services
- [Online therapy](https://www.innersparkafrica.com/online-therapy): video sessions with licensed therapists
- [Find a therapist](https://www.innersparkafrica.com/specialists): therapist profiles, specialities and languages
- [Book a session](https://www.innersparkafrica.com/book-therapist): 6-step booking, WhatsApp confirmation
- [Support groups](https://www.innersparkafrica.com/support-groups): facilitated peer groups from 25,000 UGX
- [Amani AI](https://www.innersparkafrica.com/amani-ai): free bilingual mental health assistant that helps match you to a therapist
- [Whisper](https://www.innersparkafrica.com/whisper): anonymous space to share what you are going through
- [Mind Check](https://www.innersparkafrica.com/mind-check): free validated screening tools (PHQ-9, GAD-7, WHO-5 and more)
- [Emergency support](https://www.innersparkafrica.com/emergency-support): crisis contacts and immediate help
